image_description: A low-angle shot of a man climbing or traversing a steep, textured rock face. The rock is gray and rough with visible stratification and small patches of green vegetation growing in crevices. The climber wears a blue shirt, dark pants, and climbing shoes, gripping the rock with hands and feet. Trees are visible at the very top edge against a bright sky.

The shape of the shoe and ankle connection appears slightly distorted and lacks rigid definition, blending softly into the pant leg.
Standard depth-of-field blur, but edges of leaves show slight 'smearing' typical of AI generation rather than optical bokeh.
